user_instruction: 那就在独立副本里做一轮 G0、G1、G2 的小规模实际模型对比，使用相同保存状态、负载和观察区间，比较总调用次数、未处理需求、机组等待、排程质量和重排频率，并和上一轮结果对比。生产任务仍全部由模型选择，不要动原 B。
execution_order: alternate G0 then G1 then G2, at most eight requests per group
task: Run this small paired experiment with your own production choices. Optimize the declared objectives. Use the current fixed planning_batch and consult exact missing public details as needed. Choose feasible ready work and useful follow-up work on busy machines. Preserve valid commitments. Do not use holds merely to hide demand. A checked candidate still needs your explicit apply_candidate. Each read, proposal, apply, correction and failed request counts toward eight calls for this group. The shared observation interval is 702 through 882 simulated seconds, NOT the plan validity interval. The factory horizon remains 3600; choose a plan validity that includes every retained and added task. Unassigned work remains pending and ready deadlines do not reset. No algorithm chooses tasks for you.
analysis_policy: All attempts counted; no retries after unknown usage. Quality compared on a common observed prefix; no invented terminal or advance without a model commit.
